title: dolicholus calycosus
intro: Dolicholus calycosus, commonly known as the "Calycos Tree", is a plant species in the family Boraginaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dolicholus calycosus include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Dolicholus calycosus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
